text: He founded Zion on the Holy Mountain—
Loves it far better than all the homes of Jacob put together!
everyone there is talking about you!
Egypt and Babylon, also Philistia, even Tyre, along with Cush. Word's getting around; they point them out: "This one was born again here!"
"Men and women, right and left, get born again in her!"
"This one, this one, and this one— born again, right here."
